# Appeal of Denial — Cervical Fusion (ACDF), CPT 22551

**RE: Appeal of Adverse Benefit Determination**
**Member:** Rowan Delgado
**Member ID:** W865123628
**Reference Number:** POC-9391F374E1-41425
**Date of Denial Notice:** 2026-08-18
**Governing Policy:** Cervical Fusions, S-9004-02 (https://www.bcbsnd.com/providers/policies-precertification/legacy-medical-policy/c/cervical-fusions), effective 2024-07-01

Dear Appeals Reviewer,

I am appealing the denial of my anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF), CPT 22551, which was denied on 2026-08-18 as not medically necessary. My surgeon, Dr. Marchetti, MD, has documented that this procedure is needed, and I am asking the plan to reconsider this decision using its own published criteria and the records already submitted.

## The Plan's Own Criteria for ACDF

The policy states that "ACDF) is considered medically necessary for treatment of symptomatic degenerative disease when ALL of the following criteria are met:"

The first requirement is "unremitting cervical radiculopathy and/or myelopathy (i.e., neck and arm pain) resulting in disability and/or neurological deficit that are refractory to at least six weeks of standard conservative, nonoperative management (e.g., reduced activities, exercise, analgesics, physical therapy), in the absence of progressive or severe myelopathy complex imaging studies (i.e., CT, MRI, X-ray) demonstrate at least ONE of the following at each impacted level being considered for the fusion:"

My records show this requirement is met:

- I have had 14 months of progressive neck pain, unrelieved by rest, with radicular pain, numbness into my right thumb and index finger, and weakness.
- I completed 8 weeks of supervised physical therapy, including cervical traction and postural training, from 2026-05-18 to 2026-07-13 (18 visits), as documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- I used NSAIDs for 8 months with inadequate relief.
- I received a corticosteroid injection on 2026-05-08, which gave only 3 weeks of partial relief.

This is well beyond the six weeks of conservative management referenced in the policy, and my symptoms have not resolved.

The second requirement is that imaging show at least one of: "Herniated nucleus pulposus  Spondylosis (i.e., presence of osteophytes)  Visible loss of disc height compared to adjacent levels with resultant foraminal stenosis physical examination findings and imaging studies correlate with each level being considered for the fusion."

My MRI of the cervical spine, performed 2026-06-26, shows a C5-C6 disc herniation with severe right foraminal narrowing and C6 nerve root compression. This directly matches the "Herniated nucleus pulposus" and foraminal stenosis findings described in the policy.

The policy also requires that "physical examination findings and imaging studies correlate with each level being considered for the fusion." My physical exam shows positive provocative testing on the affected side and a neurologic deficit that corresponds to the imaged level — consistent with the C6 nerve root compression shown on MRI and the radicular pain, numbness, and weakness I have in my right thumb and index finger (the C6 distribution).

Based on these records, I believe my case meets each of the criteria the plan has published for ACDF to be considered medically necessary.

## Request for the Criteria Applied

Because BCBSND writes and publishes its own medical necessity criteria, I am asking the plan to provide, in writing, the specific criteria it applied in denying this request, together with an explanation of which criterion it found unmet and why, so that I and my surgeon can respond to the specific basis for denial.

## Deadline and Submission

My appeal must be received by 2027-02-14. I am submitting this appeal to the address printed on my denial letter; if that address is not clear, I will call the number on the back of my insurance card and ask where member appeals are filed.

## Request

I am asking the plan to reconsider and reverse the denial of CPT 22551 (ACDF) based on the medical necessity criteria in Cervical Fusions, S-9004-02, and the clinical records described above. Please let me know if any additional records or documentation from my surgeon would help this review.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

______________________________
Rowan Delgado
Member ID: W865123628
Date: [date signed]
Contact phone/email: [contact information]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
